title: MissionCommand
description: QoS 1 on agri/v1/{robot_id}/cmd/mission. The bridge maps 'start' onto a Nav2 NavigateThroughPoses goal.

waypoints.description: Ordered. Required for 'start', ignored otherwise. Snake and perimeter patterns are expanded to explicit waypoints by the backend, so the robot receives one uniform representation.

auto_spray.description: Spray flagged plants during the run. Has no effect unless the sprayer is separately armed: this flag cannot arm it.

issued_by.description: User id of the operator. Written to audit_log with the command; every command is attributable to a person.

lease_id.description: Control lease held by that operator. The backend rejects a command whose lease has expired or is held by someone else.
